name: Fruit of the Sea
summary: Along Darkshore, Auberdine fisherman Gubber Blump asks you to gather crab meat. He keeps to the docks and dreams of dishes for his catch.

sections.title: A Passion for Crustaceans
sections.body: Gubber Blump fishes from Auberdine's long wooden piers, thinking of crab meat. He calls crabs the ocean's true bounty and imagines them baked, barbecued, or boiled. His recipes include whipper root crab and Ironforge surprise crab.

sections.title: Combing the Tidepools
sections.body: Gubber cannot leave his fishing rod, so he asks you to gather ingredients from Darkshore's beaches. Reef crawlers and encrusted tide crawlers move among the breakers, offering meat for a coastal cook. Mind their claws as you gather the fine crab chunks.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Fruit of the Sea?
aliases: fruit of the sea quest giver
who gives fruit of the sea
faq.answer: Gubber Blump, an Alliance fisherman on Auberdine's docks in Darkshore, asks you.

faq.q: What creatures drop the Fine Crab Chunks?
aliases: where do fine crab chunks drop
which crabs drop fine crab chunks
faq.answer: Reef crawlers and encrusted tide crawlers along Darkshore's shores and shallow surf yield Fine Crab Chunks.

faq.q: Why doesn't Gubber gather the crab meat himself?
aliases: why doesn't gubber get his own crab
faq.answer: Gubber is busy fishing from Auberdine's piers and cannot leave his line to hunt crabs on the beach.

faq.q: What dishes does Gubber want to make?
faq.answer: Gubber names crab salad, soup, stew, pepper crab, lemon crab, whipper root crab, and a regional dish he calls Ironforge surprise crab.

faq.q: Is Gubber Blump's speech referencing something?
faq.answer: Yes. Gubber's list of crab dishes echoes Benjamin Buford 'Bubba' Blue from the film Forrest Gump, whose speech about shrimp is described as identical.

faq.q: Where does this quest take place?
aliases: where is fruit of the sea
what zone is fruit of the sea in
faq.answer: It begins and ends in Auberdine, a port village, while you hunt along the shores of Darkshore in northern Kalimdor.

angles.text: Gubber's eager list of crab dishes may inspire you to make the most of local coastal catches.
As a dwarf, you may hear a familiar note of home when an outsider in northern Kalimdor dreams of Ironforge surprise crab. You travel as a Khaz Modan mountaineer.
As an Alliance traveler, you can reach Kalimdor through Auberdine, a landing hub for Alliance explorers, and help local fishermen settle in.
